abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Alvenor.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Alvenor.
section:
### Additional comparison

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.
